name: Lemon Zest
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated by SIBO patients as it contains minimal FODMAPs and provides flavor without digestive burden.
preparationTips: Use a microplane or fine grater for best texture
Only zest the yellow outer layer, avoid bitter white pith
Store fresh zest in refrigerator up to 1 week or freeze for longer storage
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like basil or thyme
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C and citrus bioflavonoids
